disclaimer: Indicative reference figures compiled for the SDK's value-realization models as of 2026-11, NOT quotes. Provider interconnect fees are public list prices copied from the providers' pricing pages and price-list APIs on the retrieval date recorded on each row (US / Zone 1 / North America where the provider varies by location); hourly rates are converted to monthly at 730 hours per month. Cloud egress rates are headline standard-tier US/North-America list prices (tiered by volume, region- and destination-dependent, excluding free-tier allowances and negotiated discounts). Equinix and on-prem figures are indicative fallbacks and market-range midpoints; real Equinix-side costs must be sourced from the live Fabric Pricing API. Use for comparative estimates only; actual costs will differ.
